meta.title: Data-Visibility Scoping: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a non-Tenant Admin and attempt to use Data-Visibility Scoping, including observing whether Procol refuses or omits it.
Repeat the same action as a Tenant Admin and compare whether the capability is available.
Verify the tenant's Enterprise plan and any deliberate RBAC configuration affecting this action.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a non-Tenant Admin and attempt to use Data-Visibility Scoping, including observing whether Procol refuses or omits it.; Repeat the same action as a Tenant Admin and compare whether the capability is available.; Verify the tenant's Enterprise plan and any deliberate RBAC configuration affecting this action.

args.need: sign in as the non-Tenant Admin and Tenant Admin users in the specified Enterprise tenant, open Data-Visibility Scoping, attempt the action as each role, and report whether it is refused, absent, or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot change user roles, access the administration setting, or perform the required same-tenant role comparison.
Check that the resulting screen has no crash or server error after the tester's role comparison.
